construction: Non-overwriting byte-preserving copy of the surviving Gate-4 venv into the user persistent data directory. The venv uses --system-site-packages over the frozen Anaconda Python/Torch installation and supplies zarr 2.18.7 plus numcodecs 0.15.1 locally.
formal_use: A formal V1R2 runner must verify this file hash, executable existence, exact live package/GPU identity, live sorted pip-freeze hash and pip check before model loading.
